fee_buffer_bps_configured.meaning: feeBufferBPS state variable exists and is configured to provide a safety buffer for msg.value

msg_value_includes_buffer.meaning: the user sends msg.value equal to the required fee plus the configured feeBufferBPS buffer

buffered_path_accepted.meaning: the buffered overpayment path (msg.value = fee + buffer) is accepted rather than rejected
buffered_path_accepted.checkpoint: at execution of the cross-chain send

buffered_path_broken.meaning: the Safe/Buffered transaction path is permanently broken (buffered send is rejected)
buffered_path_broken.checkpoint: at execution of the cross-chain send

assumptions: The cross-chain send is routed through the inherited OAppSender._lzSend function.
The buffered overpayment scenario is the one in which msg.value equals the required native fee plus the configured feeBufferBPS buffer.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether feeBufferBPS is enabled by default or must be configured before the send, nor the exact buffer value or required fee amount; the buffered scenario is therefore represented qualitatively.

limitations: The buffered path acceptance is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric fee or buffer values.
Only the broken_safe_buffered_path impact is formalized; the separate reliability-feature impact is not covered by this plan.
